rules.topics: One to three topics; primary topic first.
rules.text_form: Exactly one observed production form. Native_text is the conservative default when no OCR/transcript evidence is visible.
rules.evidence: Zero to three short exact substrings from the input text.
rules.mixed_composite: Use only for an actual concatenation of different materials/authors, not merely bilingual text.
genre_decision_order: First identify explicit specialised forms: business_response, customer_review, classified_listing, advertisement, quiz_poll, reference_result, personal_message.
Then distinguish first-party official_announcement from third-person news_report.
Use comment_reply for a context-dependent user reaction or conversational fragment.
Use social_post only as the remaining standalone social publication/caption.
Use other only when communicative function is genuinely indeterminate.
anti_catchall_rules: Publication on Telegram or another social platform is a channel clue, not a reason by itself to choose social_post.
A headline/date/byline followed by factual third-person reporting is news_report even if social links appear at the end.
A price, route, contact, product parameters, or a concrete private offer normally indicates classified_listing; broad brand promotion indicates advertisement.
A short score, schedule, track title, username list, profile, or other non-narrative metadata is reference_result, not comment_reply or social_post.
A thank-you or evaluation of a doctor, restaurant, product, course, or service is customer_review; an organisation replying to it is business_response.
A greeting or congratulations addressed to a person is personal_message.
Choose topics from the semantic subject of the text, never from incidental brand/location/entity names. Use other only when no listed subject applies.
If an explicit marker says 'Текст на изображении:' or equivalent, choose image_ocr. Repeated 'Спикер N:' or equivalent indicates speech_transcript.

register_boundaries.formal: Institutional/professional wording and consistently formal syntax.
register_boundaries.neutral: Standard factual prose without strong institutional or colloquial marking.
register_boundaries.informal: Conversational address, slang, expressive spelling, heavy emoji, or clearly casual language.
register_boundaries.mixed: Two substantial sections with contrasting registers; isolated informal words do not suffice.

definitions.news_report: Third-person factual coverage of an event: a news story, report, review, or digest. A social-channel origin does not override this genre.
definitions.official_announcement: First-party statement by a government body, institution, company, or press service in its own voice; not third-person reporting about that body.
definitions.social_post: Standalone social-feed/channel post or caption that does not meet a more specific genre below. Treat it as a fallback, not a label for every text sourced from social media.
definitions.comment_reply: Short user reaction, opinion, conversational answer, or context-dependent fragment. Prefer this over other for ordinary readable comments.
definitions.customer_review: Customer evaluation of a product, place, course, or service, even when the platform is not named.
definitions.business_response: An organisation's reply to a customer, including templated replies.
definitions.advertisement: Promotion, sale announcement, or broad call to buy/order.
definitions.classified_listing: Structured private offer with price, contact details, or item parameters.
definitions.informational_educational: Explanation, instruction, advice, or teaching material.
definitions.quiz_poll: Explicit quiz, test, poll, or audience question that requests an answer/vote. Never use merely because a text is short, imperative, or contains a rhetorical question.
definitions.reference_result: Non-narrative schedule, result, profile, list, or media metadata.
definitions.mixed_composite: One record clearly concatenates texts of different genres or authors.
definitions.other: Unreadable/minimal material with insufficient communicative function, or no suitable genre. Do not use it as a fallback for a normal comment.

definitions.politics_government: Domestic politics, elections, and public administration.
definitions.international_relations_conflict: Foreign affairs, wars, and international conflicts.
definitions.law_crime_security: Law, courts, crime, corruption, and security.
definitions.business_economy_finance: Business, economy, markets, banking, and finance.
definitions.construction_real_estate_urbanism: Real estate, construction, and urban infrastructure.
definitions.technology_telecom: IT, digital services, communications, and telecom.
definitions.transport_automotive_aviation: Cars, roads, public transport, rail, and aviation.
definitions.entertainment_music_fandom: Film, music, shows, celebrities, and fandoms.
definitions.consumer_goods_services: Food, restaurants, shops, products, and household services.
definitions.environment_agriculture: Environment, weather, natural resources, and agriculture.
definitions.other: The topic is indeterminate or outside the taxonomy.

definitions.native_text: Originally written/typed text, or no observable evidence of OCR/transcription.
definitions.speech_transcript: Speech transcribed from audio/video, often with speaker labels.
definitions.image_ocr: Text extracted from an image, often introduced by an OCR marker.

definitions.formal: Official, institutional, professional, or deliberately formal language.
definitions.neutral: Unmarked informational language without a strongly formal or conversational tone.
definitions.informal: Conversational, colloquial, emotional, or slang-heavy language.
definitions.mixed: Substantial mixture of formal and informal registers in one record.

known_schema_limitation.channel: The requested output schema defines no channel field or channel taxonomy. Agreement is therefore computed for text_form in its place; channel is reported as unavailable rather than invented post hoc.

prior_run_audit_refinement.reason: The archived Luna run showed catch-all use of social_post/comment_reply/other and confusion among topic and register boundaries.
prior_run_audit_refinement.change: Added explicit anti-catchall rules while preserving the requested label schema. No calibration stage is run in this Sol experiment.
